Title: Calling of the Twelve Apostles
DateApprox: c. AD 27-30 or AD 30-33 (approx., date debated)
KeyPersons: Jesus; Simon Peter; Andrew; James, Son of Zebedee; Philip; Matthew; Thomas
Events: Jesus calls fishermen, a tax collector, and others to follow him and appoints twelve apostles to preach and heal.
ScriptureReference: Matthew 4:18-22; Matthew 10:1-4; Mark 1:16-20; Mark 3:13-19; Luke 5:1-11; Luke 6:12-16
